ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a large cube divided into three equal parts along each edge, forming a visible 3×3×3 large-block division; on the visible faces, there are square openings in the middle positions, matching the channel structure formed after “removing the center 3×3×3 small cube of each face.” Reasoning: In the first step, from the original 27 3×3×3 large blocks, 6 face-center large blocks and 1 center large block are removed, so 27−7=20 large blocks remain. Now regard the final solid as these 20 large blocks each being reduced in the same way. First calculate one reduced 3×3×3 large block. It originally has 27 unit small cubes; removing 6 face-center unit small cubes and 1 center unit small cube leaves 20 unit small cubes. In this first-level structure, there are 24 pairs of adjacent faces among the remaining unit small cubes, so the surface area of a single reduced large block is 20·6−2·24=120−48=72. If the 20 reduced large blocks were separated from each other, the total surface area would be 20·72=1440. But these large blocks still have mutual contact in the remaining structure of the first step. There are altogether 24 shared large faces among the 20 large blocks in the first-step structure. Each shared large face is composed of 3×3 unit faces; because the center unit cube on that face of each reduced large block has been removed, the actual contact consists of the 8 unit small faces other than the center. Each shared large face makes the 8 unit faces on both sides counted in the separated count become internal faces, so for each shared large face, subtract 2·8=16. Therefore the final surface area is 1440−24·16=1440−384=1056.

method.method_draft: Treat the final solid as 20 diminished copies of a 3×3×3 block arranged in the first-stage tunnel pattern. From the image, first note the visible 3-by-3 subdivision of the large cube and the central face openings, matching the removal of face-center large cubes. From the text, the first stage leaves 20 large 3×3×3 cubes. For one diminished 3×3×3 cube, count its surface area as a level-1 Menger block: 20 unit cubes remain, with 24 adjacent unit-cube pairs, so its surface area is 20·6−2·24=72. If the 20 diminished blocks were separated, their total surface area would be 20·72=1440. Now count the adjacencies among the 20 large blocks in the first-stage arrangement: the surviving large cubes have 24 shared large faces. Across each shared large face, the diminished pattern has contact on 8 unit squares, because the central unit square on that face has been removed. Therefore each shared large-face adjacency hides 2·8=16 unit faces from the separated-copy count. Subtract 24·16 from 1440 to get 1440−384=1056.

推理：第一步中，原来的 27 个 3×3×3 大块去掉 6 个面中心大块和 1 个中心大块，所以剩下 27−7=20 个大块。现在把最终立体看成这 20 个大块各自都被同样削减。

先算一个被削减的 3×3×3 大块。它本来有 27 个单位小方块，去掉 6 个面中心单位小方块和 1 个中心单位小方块，剩下 20 个单位小方块。这个一级结构中，剩余单位小方块之间有 24 对相邻面，所以单个削减后大块的表面积为 20·6−2·24=120−48=72。

如果 20 个削减后大块彼此分离，总表面积是 20·72=1440。

但这些大块在第一步剩余结构中仍有相互接触。第一步的 20 个大块之间共有 24 个共享的大面。每个共享的大面是 3×3 个单位面组成；由于每个削减后大块在该面的中心单位方块被去掉，所以实际接触的是除中心外的 8 个单位小面。每个共享大面会让分离计数中两侧的 8 个单位面变成内部面，因此每个共享大面要减去 2·8=16。

所以最终表面积为 1440−24·16=1440−384=1056。

method.method_draft: Use a direct unit-coordinate count for the final level-2 Menger-type solid. From the image, first recognize the 3×3×3 grid and face-center tunnels; from the text, encode the two-stage construction in base 3. Label each final unit cube by coordinates x,y,z from 0 to 8, and write each coordinate with two ternary digits. A unit cube remains exactly when, at each ternary digit level, at most one of the three corresponding digits is 1. Count exposed faces perpendicular to the x-axis by fixing y,z and scanning the 9 possible x-values. For one ternary digit level of the pair (y,z): if neither digit is 1, then the x digit may be 0,1,2; if exactly one is 1, the x digit may be only 0 or 2; if both are 1, no x digit is allowed. For two digit levels, ignoring cases with no cubes, the allowed-line patterns have multiplicities 16 each: unrestricted/unrestricted gives 2 x-faces along the line, restricted in the coarse digit gives 4, restricted in the fine digit gives 8, and restricted in both gives 8. Thus the number of x-normal exposed faces is 16(2+4+8+8)=352. By symmetry the same count holds for y-normal and z-normal faces, so the total surface area is 3·352=1056.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：附图显示一个立方体被划分成 3×3×3 的较大格块；在可见的外表面上可以看到中心位置有方形通道/缺口，体现了从每个面的中心穿孔的结构。这个图像支持题目所述的第一层 3×3×3 分块和面中心被挖去的隧道形状。再推理：把最终的 9×9×9 立方体看成单位小方块，坐标记为 x,y,z=0,1,...,8。每个坐标写成两位三进制数，对应粗层和细层。一个单位小方块保留，当且仅当在每一位三进制层级中，x,y,z 三个对应数字里至多有一个等于 1。现在数垂直于 x 轴方向的外露单位面。固定 y,z，沿 x=0 到 8 扫描一条线。对某一位三进制层级，看 y,z 的对应数字：若二者都不是 1，则 x 的这一位可为 0,1,2，称为 unrestricted；若恰有一个是 1，则 x 的这一位只能为 0 或 2，称为 restricted；若二者都是 1，则这一整条线没有保留方块。对两位三进制层级，非空情形有四类，且每类 multiplicity 都是 4×4=16。两层都 unrestricted 时，沿 x 是连续 9 个方块，贡献 2 个 x 法向外露面；粗层 restricted、细层 unrestricted 时，形成两个长度为 3 的块，贡献 4 个外露面；粗层 unrestricted、细层 restricted 时，形成 4 段，贡献 8 个外露面；两层都 restricted 时，也形成 4 个孤立位置，贡献 8 个外露面。因此 x 法向外露面数为 16(2+4+8+8)=16×22=352。由立方体三方向对称，y 法向和 z 法向也各为 352，所以总表面积为 3×352=1056。

In this first-level structure, there are 24 pairs of adjacent faces among the remaining unit small cubes, so the surface area of a single reduced large block is 20·6−2·24=120−48=72.

Each shared large face makes the 8 unit faces on both sides counted in the separated count become internal faces, so for each shared large face, subtract 2·8=16.

Therefore the final surface area is 1440−24·16=1440−384=1056.
